name: Pearl Moira
source:
Next-door neighbor and long-time friend.

Having known Reggie the longest, she tends to act clingy and possessive when she finds him paying attention to others. She tends to hoard possessions based on the memories associated with the item.

Her father is the local police chief and an old pal to Dr. Happenstahnce, but she barely talks about him...

[From the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/mrtired/undead-darlings-a-visual-novel-rpg-for-pc-and-ps4]Kickstarter[/url] page]
